system.description:
Effect: You attach the cypher to another device of up to level 6, providing power to it until you use a ten-hour recovery.

Genre Items: power stone (fantasy); microgenerator (sci-fi) Typically a modern or sci-fi uninterruptible power source cypher is providing electrical power, but exotic technology might be able to activate a gasoline engine or a nuclear-powered machine.
